decisions.reason: The stacking tray builds directly on the firm's core display know-how and in-house design, printing and testing, so the firm can read market feedback and refine it through its own R&D.

The online portal lies far from the firm's paper-board expertise, which limits its ability to interpret results and improve it, but it supports the one-stop service and the firm's direction toward closer customer collaboration, so it is kept for now despite elevated risk.
The packaging display builds on established knowledge and won the Deutscher Verpackungspreis 2024, a clear validation the firm can absorb and use commercially.
The quarter-pallet pegboard display is close to the core offer and has a dedicated web page, so the firm can learn from results and adapt it with its own design and testing capacity.
The counter display is a natural extension of existing cardboard display competence with a dedicated page, giving it low risk and strong ability to improve it in-house.
The large freestanding display draws on the firm's established structural and printing know-how and fits its plan to broaden 3D cardboard offerings, so it is kept.
